name: Waiter, my spaghetti is cold!
source:
Ignoring your calls and ghosting you for weeks is one thing, giving you cold spaghetti leftovers after tracking him down is another.

[from [url=https://cripticbite.itch.io/waiter-my-spaghetti-is-cold]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
忽略你的电话并连续数周对你进行鬼影是一回事，在找到他后给你剩下的冷意大利面又是另一回事。

[来自[url=https://cripticbite.itch.io/waiter-my-spaghetti-is-cold]itch.io[/url]]
